item.title: Judge halts Virginia's new social media restrictions for minors
item.description: A federal judge on Friday agreed to halt the enforcement of Virginia's new law restricting social media use for minors while a lawsuit against the Commonwealth is underway.

item.title: One week after Shockoe Bottom mass shooting, neighbors say they feel the impact
item.description: One week after a mass shooting in Shockoe Bottom killed two people and injured seven others, business owners and families say they are still feeling the impact.

item.title: 'Place matters': Richmond social services consolidates into one new location
item.description: The Richmond Department of Social Services officially opened its new office building with a ribbon cutting ceremony Friday evening.
